title: [Plan] DIR-054: Eliminate 429 Storm on /api/messages/conversations, Shared Poller Architecture & Rate-Limit Alignment
body: DIR-054 FORENSIC RCA VALIDATED AGAINST SOURCE (measured, not assumed). RCA-1 CONFIRMED AND AMPLIFIED: FOUR independent hook instances mount, not three - CubaCandidateShell.jsx:170, MessagesNavBadge.jsx:74, ProfileDisplay.jsx:34, EmployerSidebar.jsx:194. At POLL_INTERVAL_MS=15000 that is 16 req/min = 80 requests per 5-minute window against a 30-request budget, so the quota is exhausted in about 1.9 minutes and every later tick 429s - exactly the 52-error console storm the User reported. RCA-2 CONFIRMED: backend/security/abuse.js:132-136 declares MESSAGING_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT default 30 over windowMs 300000, and backend/index.js:554 mounts it globally on all of /api/messages, so GET badge reads share one budget with POST mutations. generalApiLimiter (120/min, index.js:482-485) is NOT the binding constraint. RCA-3 CONFIRMED: useUnreadMessages.js:99 uses a fixed setInterval(refresh, POLL_INTERVAL_MS) and the catch at :64-68 only sets status error, so the timer keeps firing forever with zero Retry-After respect and zero backoff. RCA-4 CONFIRMED: apiJson (platform.js:170-191) issues a bare fetch with cache no-store, no in-flight promise reuse and no TTL - unlike the proven fetchPublicConfig precedent (platform.js:150-168: publicConfigInFlight + PUBLIC_CONFIG_TTL_MS=15000 snapshot) which should be mirrored. RCA-5 CONFIRMED WITH EXACT EVIDENCE: node --test tests/dir023-contrast-tokens.test.mjs yields 14 pass / 1 FAIL - unmapped light-shade opacity classes: bg-amber-50/95, border-amber-300/70, dark:text-amber-100/80 - all three originating from the DIR-053 reconnect banner at src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateHero.jsx:201 and :206. CORRECTION TO THE SPEC: the directive names src/components/cuba/CubaCandidateHero.jsx, which DOES NOT EXIST; the real file is src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateHero.jsx. CONSTRAINTS THAT MUST SURVIVE: tests/messaging-module-gate.test.mjs:112 pins /POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15000/, :113 pins addEventListener focus refresh, :101 pins the exact returned object shape, :105 pins data totalUnread, :108/:109 pin the fail-visible error path, :116-120 pin resolveMessagesVisibility and setModuleEnabled(false), :123 forbids conf/fire. cuba-tokens.css (2591 lines) currently contains ZERO dark:-prefixed doubled selectors, so inventing one is riskier than reusing already-mapped classes. PLAN: S1 split the coarse messaging limiter into a generous READ tier (namespace messaging-read, MESSAGING_READ_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT default 300 per 5 min = 60/min, 3.75x headroom over the post-S2 worst case of 16/min, failClosed false per the publicBrowse/generalApi coarse-tier precedent) applied only to GET/HEAD on /api/messages/conversations, plus the mutation tier raised from 30 to 150 per spec S1 while KEEPING failClosed true because a mutation budget must stay fail-closed; register both env keys in backend/services/platformConfiguration.js around line 150; preserve the DIR-026 module gate ordering at index.js:571 and the post-requireAuth mount. S2 convert useUnreadMessages.js into a module-level singleton store (subscribers Set + shared snapshot + inflight promise + lastFetchedAt) so exactly ONE interval and ONE network read exist no matter how many components mount, keeping the literal POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15000, the window focus listener, and the exact returned contract; every consumer reads the same snapshot so all four call sites stay identical and truthful. S3 replace the fixed interval with a self-scheduling setTimeout loop and a Retry-After circuit breaker - extend apiJson ADDITIVELY to attach err.retryAfter from the response Retry-After header (response headers are currently discarded at platform.js:182-189) - with exponential backoff 15s to 30s to 60s to 120s to 240s capped at 300s, resetting to 15s on any success, and logging the outage transition ONCE instead of per tick. S4 fix the contrast regression at the component, which is the option the spec authorises, by using already-mapped classes: bg-amber-50/95 to bg-amber-50/90 (mapped at cuba-tokens.css:1941), border-amber-300/70 to border-amber-300/80 (mapped at cuba-tokens.css:2203), and dark:text-amber-100/80 to the bare dark:text-amber-100. Deliberately NOT adding new !important maps, because a doubled-selector !important rule for bg-amber-50/95 or border-amber-300/70 would beat the banner own dark:bg-amber-500/10 and dark:border-amber-400/40 overrides and re-create the very pastel-island defect DIR-023 exists to prevent. Net result: 15/15 green with ZERO CSS churn. S5 verification: npm run test:security:static, npm run lint, npm test, npm run build under the 4.0s budget, a new regression suite pinning single-interval coalescing, the backoff ladder, Retry-After honouring and the 300/150 defaults, and a live XAMPP-served Playwright capture of https://ime365.local/dashboard for at least 6 continuous minutes asserting 0 x 429 on /api/messages/conversations, exactly one request per 15s tick, 0 console errors and clean badge sync, then bridge dev submit-evidence. All servers strictly via XAMPP; no detached background server processes.

steps: S1 backend/security/abuse.js - add messagingReadAccountLimiter (namespace messaging-read, MESSAGING_READ_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT default 300 per 5min, failClosed false) and raise messagingAccountLimiter default 30 to 150 (failClosed true stays)
export both
S2 backend/services/platformConfiguration.js - register MESSAGING_READ_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT alongside MESSAGING_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT so the admin panel can tune both

S3 backend/index.js line 554 - replace the blanket app.use /api/messages messagingAccountLimiter mount with a method-aware dispatcher routing GET/HEAD to messagingReadAccountLimiter and all other methods to messagingAccountLimiter, keeping the DIR-026 module gate at line 571 after it and after requireAuth
S4 src/services/api/platform.js apiJson - additively attach err.retryAfter from the Retry-After response header, no change to existing callers

S5 src/hooks/useUnreadMessages.js - extract a module-level singleton store (subscribers Set, shared snapshot, inflight promise, lastFetchedAt) with exactly one refcounted scheduler shared by all consumers, preserving POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15000, the window focus listener and the returned { unreadCount, error, status, enabled, refresh } object

S6 src/hooks/useUnreadMessages.js - replace setInterval with a self-scheduling setTimeout loop implementing exponential backoff 15s/30s/60s/120s/240s capped at 300s, honouring Retry-After on 429 and 503, resetting to 15s on success and logging the outage transition once
S7 src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateHero.jsx lines 201 and 206 - swap bg-amber-50/95 to bg-amber-50/90, border-amber-300/70 to border-amber-300/80, dark:text-amber-100/80 to dark:text-amber-100
S8 add regression tests covering poller coalescing, the backoff ladder, Retry-After honouring and the read/mutation limiter split
S9 run npm run test:security:static, npm run lint, npm test, npm run build
S10 live XAMPP Playwright 6-minute dashboard poll capture asserting 0 x 429 and 0 console errors, saved under .bridge/evidence/

title: [P0] DIR-055: Unified Executive Builder Header ("Best of Both Worlds") & Real Interactive Notifications Pipeline
body:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
The User compared the legacy Resume Builder header with the current interface and inspected the Notifications popover on https://ime365.local/dashboard.
The User strictly commands:
'this is my old header but new one is not as good as this. can you get the best of both worlds? Add New directive. Also Notifications are not real, not working. ask developer to fix this pipeline After the current one is done'.
Mandate:
1. Merge the rich functional ergonomics of the legacy Resume Builder header (prominent Dashboard exit, editable title, template selector dropdown pill, live save beacon, ATS score pill with drawer trigger, Share, Sync Profile, Preview, and Download CTAs, plus the horizontal step ribbon with completed checkmarks and progress overview) with the modern Cuba glassmorphic design system ('best of both worlds'), eliminating any double-header clutter.
2. Completely overhaul the Notifications pipeline: eliminate stale duplicate placeholders ('New message 4d ago'), resolve real navigable hrefs per notification type, add working 'Mark all as read' and per-row read toggles, and wire real MariaDB notification generation with sender/snippet grounding.

### 2. ROOT CAUSE & ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATION
1. RCA-1 (Builder Header Layout & Feature Regression):
   In BuildResume.jsx and AuthenticatedAppShell.jsx, mounting inside CubaCandidateShell can lead to dual topbar crowding or suppression of dedicated builder controls. The legacy header provided superior density:
   - Left: '<- Dashboard' pill, title rename, template selector dropdown pill ('Professional Classic v'), and live 'Saved' beacon.
   - Center: Interactive ATS pill ('ATS: 39/100 | Getting Started v') opening the ATS score breakdown drawer.
   - Right: 'Share', 'Sync Profile', 'Preview' (eye icon), and high-contrast 'Download' CTA.
   - Ribbon: Horizontal stepper with '<' / '>' scroll arrows, completed green checkmarks '(v)', active step pill, and 'X of 10 complete - XX% v' overview trigger.
2. RCA-2 (Dead & Fake Notifications Pipeline):
   - In MariaDB 'notifications', 25 stale identical rows ('New message / You have a new message' 4d ago) exist without sender attribution.
   - In M3NotificationCenter.jsx, 'onClick={() => onNavigate?.(item.href)}' is completely dead because 'notifications' rows do NOT store or return an 'href'. Clicks fail silently.
   - No 'Mark all as read' action exists in the UI; unread badge remains permanently stuck at 25.
   - 'onOpenAll' redirects blindly to '/dashboard' instead of a real notifications/activity destination.

### 3. TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION STEPS (S1 - S6)
- S1: Unified 'Best of Both Worlds' Builder Header in BuildResume.jsx
  - Redesign BuildResume header into a premium Cuba glassmorphic surface (backdrop-blur, refined slate/cuba border tokens, full dark-mode compatibility).
  - Cleanly integrate or adapt the shell so the builder presents a dedicated, un-crowded topbar with:
    * '<- Dashboard' exit pill.
    * Click-to-edit resume title + template selector dropdown pill (Cv1-Cv51 with search/preview).
    * Live auto-save beacon ('* Saved' / 'Saving...' / 'Error').
    * Interactive ATS score pill with tone color and drawer trigger.
    * Quick Actions: 'Share', 'Sync Profile', 'Preview' (eye icon), and high-contrast primary 'Download'.
  - Elevate the Horizontal Step Navigation Ribbon: '<' and '>' scroll arrows, completed green checkmark pills, active step highlighting, and 'X of 10 complete - XX%' overview trigger.
- S2: Real Navigable Hrefs & Bulk Read in Backend
  - In backend/routes/notificationsData.js and backend/repositories/MySQLRepository.js:
    * Map each notification row to a real client 'href':
      - message -> '/dashboard/messages?conversation=' + (data.conversationId || '')
      - application -> '/dashboard/jobs'
      - interview -> '/dashboard/interviews'
      - system -> '/dashboard'
    * Add 'POST /api/notifications-data/mark-all-read' marking all rows for req.user.uid as is_read = 1.
- S3: Interactive Notifications UI in M3NotificationCenter.jsx
  - Add 'Mark all as read' button in popover header calling 'POST /api/notifications-data/mark-all-read'.
  - Make notification rows interactive: clicking marks the individual notification as read ('PATCH /api/notifications-data/:id') and routes to 'item.href'.
  - Render contextual icons (message icon for messages, briefcases for job applications, calendars for interviews).
  - Format honest relative timestamps and clean empty state ('You are all caught up') when all are read.
- S4: Real Notification Generation in Backend
  - In backend/index.js message sending route ('POST /api/messages/conversations/:id/messages'), ensure notifications include real sender name, conversation ID, and message snippet in data.
  - Mark or clean up the stale 4-day-old duplicate test notifications in MariaDB for uid OhZdiSIFL7ePA1TMkfu9bnR935D3.
- S5: Responsive Validation & Accessibility
  - Verify builder header and step ribbon across 375px, 768px, and 1280px viewports with zero horizontal overflow or clipping.
  - Ensure all buttons have unique aria-labels and keyboard focus rings.
- S6: E2E Verification & Evidence Pack
  - Author regression tests for notification routes (href resolution, mark-all-read).
  - Run npm test, npm run lint, and Playwright DOM crawl verifying:
    1. Builder header renders 'best of both worlds' controls cleanly.
    2. Notifications open, navigate to real links, mark as read, and update badge in real time.

### 4. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC-1: Resume Builder presents the complete 'best of both worlds' header (Dashboard exit, title, template selector, live save status, ATS pill, Share, Sync Profile, Preview, Download, and completed checkmark stepper ribbon) in premium Cuba styling.
- AC-2: Notifications popover displays real, non-placeholder notifications with actionable navigation hrefs.
- AC-3: Clicking a notification navigates to its destination and marks it as read.
- AC-4: 'Mark all as read' clears the unread badge and updates MariaDB state.
- AC-5: 0 console errors, 100% test pass in npm test, and zero regression against frozen baselines.

That distinction changes the fix from rewriting the producer to remediating legacy rows plus wiring navigation. (6) The token layer the Lead asks me to define is already complete and certified by DIR-048: cuba-tokens.css has --cuba-glass-bg and --cuba-glass-border and --cuba-glass-blur at 185-189, --cuba-shadow-xl at 243, scrollbar tokens at 247-249, --cuba-z-popover 70 at 261, --cuba-header-menu-border at 270, --cuba-popover-bg at 278, --cuba-header-divider at 279, --cuba-header-badge-fill at 285, dark overrides at 469-493 and 556-570, and the Tailwind bridge at 634-656, while cuba-glass, cuba-popover, cuba-scrollbar and cuba-focusable already exist as classes. I will REUSE these and invent zero new tokens, because inventing parallel tokens is the actual regression risk. (7) Every UX state the Lead demands already has a primitive: CubaSkeleton, CubaEmptyState, CubaErrorState, CubaDrawer, CubaInlineNotice, CubaModal all exist under src/components/cuba. CONTRACT BOUNDARIES AND INVARIANTS: ZERO database schema change, the notifications table at 001_baseline.sql:369-386 is untouched and its data JSON column is the only extension point, so no migration is added and the MariaDB schema baseline stays at diff 0. The only new route is POST /api/notifications-data/mark-all-read, owner-scoped with WHERE user_id = ? AND is_read = 0, and it cannot collide with the pinned forbidden regex router.post single-quote slash colon id at tests/notification-lifecycle.test.mjs:25. The href is the Lead-approved /dashboard/messages. ### 2. CORE RESPONSIBILITY (DEVELOPER-AUTHORED SUB-DIRECTIVES)
The Developer must NOT wait for the user or Lead to hand over individual bug reports. The Developer must:
1. Conduct deep forensic discovery across the real codebase, database, routes, and UI.
2. Formulate and construct specific, actionable engineering sub-directives for every discovered defect.
3. Submit the sub-directives to the Lead Supervisor for formal review.
4. STRICT APPROVAL GATE: The Developer must NOT begin unapproved implementation until the Lead Supervisor verifies the findings, evaluates trade-offs, and issues the explicit GREEN SIGNAL approval for each sub-directive.

### 3. MANDATORY DISCOVERY SURFACES
A. Architecture & Backend Boundaries: API contracts, authentication/authorization, tenant isolation, database integrity, error responses.
B. Dashboard Completeness: Candidate, Employer, and Admin dashboards; verify real MariaDB data hydration vs hardcoded/empty stubs, accurate KPIs, and responsive layouts.
C. UI/UX, Interaction & Modals: Every route, button, modal, popup, and navigation link must have a verified outcome (zero dead views, blank screens, or unstyled dialogs).
D. System-Wide Document Print, PDF & Export Pipelines: Audit all print and export surfaces across the codebase (including recruiter applicant resume printing in EmployerApplicantPipeline, cover letters, invoices, interview coaching, and all 51 CV templates) to eliminate unstyled iframes, unconstrained avatars/photos, and multi-page whitespace sprawl.
E. Business Logic & Integrations: End-to-end data flow (e.g. Job Applications vs Kanban Job Tracker, saved favorites across documents and jobs, billing coupons vs module toggles).

### 4. MANDATORY 10-POINT FORMAT FOR EACH SUB-DIRECTIVE
Every sub-directive proposed by the Developer must provide:
1. Directive Title & Proposed ID
2. Evidence & Findings (exact file paths, line numbers, routes, reproduction steps, current vs expected)
3. Objective
4. Scope (files/modules changed, boundaries, exclusions)
5. Implementation Strategy
6. Acceptance Criteria (measurable, observable conditions)
7. Verification Plan (unit, integration, Playwright E2E, DOM crawl)
8. Risks & Dependencies
9. Priority & Severity (P0, P1, P2, P3)
10. Estimated Effort

### 5. EXECUTION SEQUENCE
- Step 1: Execute systematic forensic discovery across the codebase.
- Step 2: Author the Master Enhancement Backlog and detailed sub-directives.
- Step 3: Submit the proposed sub-directives via bridge dev plan for Lead review.
- Step 4: Await Lead approval before writing implementation code.
